Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #245 in Moneo: instrumentation.ts touches `process.report` and other Node-only startup code, which gives an Edge-runtime warning at build time.

1. Run `npm run build` and check whether the warning still appears. If it doesn't, comment on the issue with the evidence (`gh issue comment 245`) and stop without opening a PR.
2. If it does, read the instrumentation guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/. Move the Node-only work behind the supported boundary, for example a dynamic import of a Node-only module under `NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs'`.
3. Keep the startup order: undici networking config, Workflow, scheduler, bank return listener. The desktop standalone build must still work.

## RESUME: earlier work may exist
A stopped agent may have left uncommitted work in `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-ed0fca5a-64c8deb03b9c4d32` (branch `t3/issue-245-edge-instrumentation`).
- Inspect it read-only (`git -C <path> status`/`diff`) and bring over anything useful.
- Never modify, reset or delete that worktree.
- Use your own branch `t3/issue-245-edge-startup` from current `origin/main`.
- Commit as soon as the earlier work is applied.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 245 --comments`.
- End each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Don't end your turn while a command is still running.** Wait for installs and builds in the same turn: a foreground command with a long timeout, or a background command plus `t3_background_wait`. Finish the whole task before replying.
- **Never kill a process you didn't start yourself in this session, verified by PID.** Never kill by name or command line.
- Run one `npm ci` at a time. If it stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- Shared test backend:
  - Never run `npm run qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`.
  - Never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`).
- Before finishing, run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`. If 5-second timeouts under load show up in files you didn't touch, report them but don't change them.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #245`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

export async function register() {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME !== "nodejs") return;
  const { Agent, setGlobalDispatcher } = await import("undici");
  setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ keepAliveTimeout: 60_000, keepAliveMaxTimeout: 600_000 }));
  (process.report as NodeJS.ProcessReport & { excludeNetwork: boolean }).excludeNetwork = true;
  if (process.env.MONEO_DESKTOP === "1" && process.env.MONEO_DESKTOP_PREVIEW === "1") return;
  const { getWorld } = await import("workflow/runtime");
  await getWorld().start?.();
  const { startScheduler } = await import("@/lib/scheduler");
  startScheduler();
  const { startBankReturnListener } = await import("@/lib/bank/return-listener");
  startBankReturnListener();
}

**Priority:** P2 (incremental follow-up).

## Problem and current evidence

instrumentation.ts guards register() with NEXT_RUNTIME but directly accesses process.report. The earlier build reported an Edge runtime warning. Confirm the warning against the current build before fixing.

## Scope

Read the installed Next.js instrumentation guidance. Move Node-only startup work behind the supported runtime boundary or dynamic module, preserving undici configuration, Workflow startup, scheduler and bank return listener order. Keep desktop preview behaviour intact.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source build completes without the process.report Edge warning.
- [ ] Node startup still configures networking and starts the required local services once.
- [ ] Desktop standalone build and preview startup remain correct.
- [ ] No Node-only module becomes reachable from an Edge/client bundle.
- [ ] Use an existing startup check or focused test where behaviour is meaningful.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.

Fixed: the Edge warning is gone and the change is in PR #258 (https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/258), which is not merged.

- **Cause:** `instrumentation.ts` read `process.report` at module level, so the bundler still saw a Node-only API in the Edge bundle even under the `NEXT_RUNTIME` guard.
- **Fix:** the Node startup sequence moved unchanged into `instrumentation-node.ts` as `startNodeRuntime()`. `instrumentation.ts` now imports it only when `NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs'`. The order is unchanged: undici, Workflow, scheduler, bank return listener.
- **Evidence:** `npm run build` printed the warning before and no longer prints it after. `npm test` passed (1717 tests), and so did `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `instrumentation.test.ts` (9/9).
- **Desktop:** `npm run desktop:build` completes the Next standalone build and bundles the main process. It then reports `desktop/.build/backend` and `storage-api` missing, so packaging and `desktop:smoke` were not run.
- **Earlier worktree:** `t3-ed0fca5a` was clean, so there was no earlier work to bring over.
- **Issue:** commented on #245 with the summary.

Checks on the PR were still pending when I stopped: `checks` and `database` are running, and GitGuardian passed.
